title: So riesgo de: aceptar una consecuencia posible

sections.content: So riesgo de (at the risk of) names a possible negative consequence that someone accepts, or fails to avoid, in taking an action -- a fairly formal, literary construction well suited to historical narration about risky political gambles. It's followed by a noun phrase or infinitive. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Serrano actuó, so riesgo de un rechazo generalizado, sin el respaldo firme de su propio ejército.
items.english: Serrano acted, at the risk of widespread rejection, without the firm backing of his own army.

items.spanish: Algunos líderes insistieron en su plan, so riesgo de perder el apoyo que aún conservaban.
items.english: Some leaders insisted on their plan, at the risk of losing what support they still had.

items.spanish: El gobierno avanzó con la reforma, so riesgo de provocar una reacción social que no podía controlar del todo.
items.english: The government moved forward with the reform, at the risk of provoking a social reaction it couldn't fully control.

items.spanish: Nadie estaba dispuesto, so riesgo de repetir errores pasados, a ignorar por completo las señales de alerta.
items.english: No one was willing, at the risk of repeating past mistakes, to completely ignore the warning signs.

sections.content: So riesgo de is more formal than the everyday con el riesgo de -- reach for it in historical or analytical writing describing a calculated (or miscalculated) political gamble.
